US congressional districts by party

US congressional districts (119th Congress, 2025-2027) colored by the party of the sitting House representative. Grey = vacant seat. Districts marked “delegate” (DC + territories) elect non-voting members. “Voting districts” here means House districts; precinct-level (VTD) results are a much larger dataset with no single open national party source. Geometry: US Census cartographic boundaries (1:500k). Members & party: the public-domain unitedstates/congress-legislators dataset.
